cliApprove.title: Approve a terminal sign-in
cliApprove.body: Type the code the terminal shows.
cliApprove.check: Check that this is the sign-in you started.
cliApprove.scope: It gets full access as you, until you sign it out in Signed-in devices or its time runs out.
cliApprove.done: Approved. You can go back to the terminal.
cliApprove.wrong: That code doesn't match a sign-in. Check it and try again.
cliApprove.expired: That sign-in has expired. Start it again in the terminal.
cliApprove.mustChange: Change your password first, then approve the sign-in.
cliApprove.admin: An installation admin can't approve a terminal sign-in.
devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.intro: Terminals signed in as you. Signing one out stops it at once.
devices.name: Name
devices.emptyText: Sign in from a terminal with selfcloud login, and it appears here.
devices.revokeBody: Its terminal stops working at once and must sign in again.
cliApprove.named: The name was chosen by the terminal. It is not checked.
cliApprove.warning: Approve only a code you started yourself, in your own terminal. Never type a code someone else gave you.
